paragraphs.zh: Schritt 3: 2-Chlor-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-acetophenon 223.48 g (1.04 mol) 2-Chlor-3-methyl-4-methylthio-acetophenon wurden in 1.8 l Eisessig gelöst und mit 27.47 g (0.08 mol) Natriumwolframat versetzt. Anschließend ließ man unter Kühlung 203.83 g einer 30 %igen Wasserstoffperoxidlösung zutropfen und 1.5 d bei Raumtemperatur nachrühren. Es wurde mit 1.5 l Wasser verdünnt, der ausgefallenen Festtsoff abgesaugt und mit Wasser gewaschen und getrocknet. Ausbeute: 123.35 g (48 % der Theorie), farblose Kristalle, Fp.: 110-111 °C 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 2.62 (s,3H), 2.8 (s,3H), 3.12 (s,3H), 7.38 (d,1H), 8.08 (d,1H)
paragraphs.en: Step 3: 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-acetophenone 223.48 g (1.04 mol) of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylthio-acetophenone were dissolved in 1.8 l of glacial acetic acid and sodium tungstate, 27.47 g (0.08 mol), was added. 203.83 g of a 30 % strength hydrogen peroxide solution were then added dropwise with cooling and the mixture was stirred for a further 1.5 d at room temperature. It was diluted with 1.5 l of water, the precipitated solid was filtered off with suction and washed with water and dried. Yield: 123.35 g (48 % of theory), colourless crystals, m.p.: 110-111 °C 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 2.62 (s,3H), 2.8 (s,3H), 3.12 (s,3H), 7.38 (d,1H), 8.08 (d,1H)
paragraphs.notes: The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication of PCT/EP99/06627 and not Chinese. In the printed line the leading 1 of '1H NMR' is a superscript and the 3 of CDCl3 is a subscript; both are transcribed inline because the field is plain text. 'Festtsoff' is printed exactly so; it is a typographical error for 'Feststoff' and is transcribed as printed, not corrected. The volume unit after 1.8 and after 1.5 is a lower-case l for litre, which in this scan is nearly indistinguishable from a capital I; read as litre from the context of a solvent volume, and this is the only inference of a character shape made on the page. A small stray ink squiggle sits in the right-hand margin just above the 'Schritt 3:' line; it is a scan artifact, not a character. '0.08 mol' of sodium tungstate against 1.04 mol of substrate is transcribed as printed and is consistent with a catalytic charge.

paragraphs.zh: Schritt 4: 2-Chlor-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoesäure 60 g (0,24 mol) 2-Chlor-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-acetophenon wurden in 510 ml Dioxan gelöst und mit 870 g 13 %ige Natriumhypochloritlösung versetzt. Anschließend wurde noch 1 h auf 80 °C erwärmt. Nachdem Abkühlen wurde die untere Phase abgetrennt, mit Wasser verdünnt und mit Salzsäure angesäuert. Der ausgefallenen Feststoff wurde abgesaugt, mit Wasser gewaschen und getrocknet. Ausbeute: 53.02 g (88 % der Theorie), farblose Kristalle, Fp.: 230-231 °C 1H NMR (Me2SO-d6): δ 2.75 (s,3H), 3.3 (s,3H), 7.75 (d,1H), 7.98 (d,1H)
paragraphs.en: Step 4: 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoic acid 60 g (0.24 mol) of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-acetophenone were dissolved in 510 ml of dioxane and 870 g of 13 % strength sodium hypochlorite solution were added. The mixture was then heated at 80 °C for a further 1 h. After cooling, the lower phase was separated off, diluted with water and acidified with hydrochloric acid. The precipitated solid was filtered off with suction, washed with water and dried. Yield: 53.02 g (88 % of theory), colourless crystals, m.p.: 230-231 °C 1H NMR (Me2SO-d6): δ 2.75 (s,3H), 3.3 (s,3H), 7.75 (d,1H), 7.98 (d,1H)
paragraphs.notes: The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication of PCT/EP99/06627 and not Chinese. In the printed line the leading 1 of '1H NMR' is a superscript and the 3 of CDCl3 is a subscript; both are transcribed inline because the field is plain text. The decimal separator in '0,24 mol' is a comma here while every other quantity on the page uses a full stop; transcribed as printed. '13 %ige' and 'Nachdem Abkühlen' and 'Der ausgefallenen Feststoff' are printed exactly so and are grammatically irregular German ('13 %iger', 'Nach dem Abkühlen', 'Der ausgefallene Feststoff'); transcribed as printed and translated to the evident sense. In the NMR line the 2 of Me2SO is a subscript and the d6 is printed in italic.

paragraphs.zh: Schritt 5: Methyl 2-Chlor-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoat 53.02 g (0.21 mol) 2-Chlor-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoesäure wurden in 400 ml Methanol gelöst und bei Rückflußtemperatur 3 h mit HCl begast. Anschließend ließ man abkühlen und engte am Roatationsverdampfer vollständig ein. Ausbeute: 54.93 g (98 % der Theorie), farblose Kristalle, Fp.: 107-108 °C 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 2.82 (s,3H), 3.15 (s,3H), 3.98 (s,3H), 7.65 (d,1H), 8.04 (d,1H)
paragraphs.en: Step 5: methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoate 53.02 g (0.21 mol) of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoic acid were dissolved in 400 ml of methanol and HCl was bubbled in at reflux temperature for 3 h. The mixture was then allowed to cool and was concentrated to dryness on a rotary evaporator. Yield: 54.93 g (98 % of theory), colourless crystals, m.p.: 107-108 °C 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 2.82 (s,3H), 3.15 (s,3H), 3.98 (s,3H), 7.65 (d,1H), 8.04 (d,1H)
